notes.title: Inugami: Doggy Dojo! for Mac OS added!
Cherry Kiss Complete Adult VN Bundle!
notes.content:

[h1]Every Visual Novel published by Cherry Kiss Games all part of one massive bundle! This is the best time to complete your Cherry Kiss collection.[/h1]

To celebrate the first-ever Visual Novel sale on Steam we've put together the ultimate Cherry Kiss bundle! All our games in one complete-the-set bundle, so if you already are a fan and have purchased some of our titles in the past now is the perfect time to complete your collection at a discounted price!

Everything from a cute romance between you and a harem of fluffy-tailed girls in Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition to hardcore Elf domination in Elf Breeding Farm. There is something for everyone in our 15 game catalog, so what are you waiting for? Jump in now with the biggest bundle we've got baby!
